summary: This Advent sermon explores Jesus as the Prince of Peace (Sar Shalom in Hebrew), meaning the ruler of wholeness and completeness. The speaker traces how God's Old Testament promises—from Eden through Noah and Abraham—culminate in Jesus's birth, which restores the broken relationship between humanity and God, offering a peace that transcends worldly circumstances.
key_points: Sar Shalom means ruler of wholeness/completeness, not merely absence of conflict
Sin separated humanity from God's presence in Eden; Jesus restores that wholeness
God's covenant promises (rainbow to Noah, blood covenant with Abraham) pointed to Jesus taking our punishment
Jesus fulfilled over 300 prophecies, proving God's plan was always in motion
True peace comes from trusting God, grasping his love, and pursuing reconciliation with others
big_idea: Jesus is the Prince of Peace who restores the wholeness broken by sin, fulfilling God's ancient promises to take our punishment and give us access to his presence again.
title: C3 KIDS Present: "Not So Silent Night"
